summary: Prepare for the PECB ISO/IEC 17025 Lead Assessor exam with five days of laboratory assessment training and practical exercises.
audienceIntro: ISO/IEC 17025 Lead Assessor training is for professionals who need to assess laboratory competence, prepare for accreditation assessments, or maintain conformance with the standard.
prerequisites: You need a fundamental understanding of ISO/IEC 17025 and comprehensive knowledge of assessment principles and techniques.
